name: Book from Sven's Farm
summary: The Book from Sven's Farm is a dirt-stained, untitled journal unearthed from the ruins of Sven Yorgen's ransacked homestead in Duskwood. Its fragmented entries reveal that an unknown onlooker witnessed the massacre of Sven's family, sparking a relentless hunt across the shadowed woods.

sections.title: A Clue in the Dirt
sections.body: Buried in a loose dirt mound amid the charred remains of Sven's farm in southern Duskwood, this unassuming, weather-damaged volume contains the frantic notes of an anonymous wanderer. The entries offer incomplete glimpses into the tragedy that struck the farmstead, confirming Sven Yorgen's darkest suspicion: someone lurked in the shadows while his family was slain. Because the narrative cuts off abruptly, the book raises more questions than answers, prompting investigators to carry it back to Darkshire in search of anyone who recognizes the handwriting or its enigmatic author.

sections.title: Unraveling the Shadowy Figure
sections.body: Taking the journal to the mystics and townsfolk of Darkshire reveals that its true owner was not a native of Darkshire, yet fled through the woods in sheer terror. Tracing the faded impressions on its pages eventually leads to Jitters, a cowardly vagrant hiding in the forest. The missing passages belonging to this volume chronicle how the Defias Brotherhood meddled with forbidden artifacts, inadvertently unleashing the ravenous worgen into Duskwood. Finding Jitters piecemeals the narrative back together, culminating in his completed journal.

faq.q: Where is the Book from Sven's Farm found?
faq.answer: The book is buried inside an unkempt dirt mound at the ruined farmstead of Sven Yorgen, located in southern Duskwood.

faq.q: Who wrote the book found at Sven's farm?
faq.answer: The book bears no title or name. Its author is a terrified man who fled a horror elsewhere in Duskwood and hid in Sven's barn, witnessing the slaughter of Sven's family before losing his journal.

faq.q: Why does Sven Yorgen want this book?
faq.answer: Sven saw an unknown figure skulking near his barn after the attack on his family. The book proves that onlooker was real, providing Sven with his only tangible lead toward finding out what truly occurred that night.

faq.q: What happens to the book after you investigate it?
faq.answer: After showing the partial volume to various residents in Darkshire and tracking down its owner, the incomplete book is eventually replaced by Jitters' Completed Journal, which tells the full story.

faq.q: What larger secret is connected to the book's contents?
aliases: what lore is in sven book
faq.answer: The full journal explains what drove its author into hiding and why Sven's family was attacked, and its story reaches far beyond one farm to the darkness that has fallen over Duskwood.

angles.text: For Alliance investigators, this weathered book is the key to solving the eerie horrors paralyzing southern Duskwood and discovering how the feral worgen pack gained a foothold.
